senses.gloss: (b. h. שאה)to stand still, pause; to dwell, tarry.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 2:3">Shebu. II, 3</cite> <he>או שש׳ בכדי השתחוואה</he> or if the unclean person stayed in the Temple long enough for prostration.
<cite ref="Shevuot 17a:8">Ib. 17ᵃ</cite> (mixed dict.) <he>בדלא ש׳</he> when he did not stand still (but walked constantly though slowly).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 6:7">Yeb. VI, 7</cite> <he>נשא אשה וש׳ עמה וכ׳</he> if one married a woman and lived with her ten years without issue.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 6:7">Ib.</cite> <he>רשאי השני  לִשְׁהוֹת וכ׳</he> the second husband may live with her ten years. Ib. 36ᵇ <he>כל ששהא וכ׳</he> a human birth that survived thirty days (although born in the eighth month) is not considered an abortion; <cite ref="Shabbat 135b:13">Sabb. 135ᵇ</cite> <he>ששהה</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ber. V, 1</cite> <he>חסידים … שׁוֹהִין שעה וכ׳</he> the pious men of olden times used to tarry a while (in the synagogue) before prayer &c.

Ib. 32ᵇ היו שוהין שעה … וחוזרין ושוהין וכ׳ they waited an hour, and prayed an hour, and tarried again an hour (at synagogue); a. fr.—Esp. (ritual) to pause during the act of slaughtering (which makes the animal so cut unfit to eat).
<cite ref="Chullin 2b:9">Ḥull. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא יִשְׁהוּ וכ׳</he> they might pause, might press the knife &c., v. <cite ref="U00304"><he>שְׁהִיָּיה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 31a">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>מהוך שמַשְׁהִין עצמן וכ׳</he> because they restrain themselves (retard effusion) &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 76a:25">Snh. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>המַשְׁהֶא בתו וכ׳</he> he who retards (the marriage of) his marriageable daughter.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:12">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>והן מַשְׁהִין אותן וכ׳</he> and they (the sons of Eli) caused them to stay away from their home one night.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37">Lev. R. s. 37</cite>, beg. <he>שנודר ומשהה וכ׳</he> who vows (a sacrifice) and procrastinates the fulfilment of his vow.
Ib. ע״י שנדר ושָׁהָה את נדרו (perh. שִׁהָה, Pi.) because he had vowed and was procrastinating &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 61a:12">Keth. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>הכל משהין בפני השמש וכ׳</he> you may postpone every dish before the waiter (keep him from eating while he is serving), except &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: same, to delay the use of, let stand. Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ top אסור לְשָׁהוֹתוֹ ואם שִׁיהוֹ וכ׳ (or לַשְׁהוֹתוֹ, Hif.) you must not let it stand, but if one did, and it turned into vinegar &c.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 2a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ואם שִׁיהָן</he> and if one did let them stand; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:4">R. Hash. IV, 4</cite> <he>פעם אחת נִשְׁתָּהוּ … מלבוא</he> once the witnesses (that had seen the new moon rise) were delayed from coming (were late).
<cite ref="Niddah 27a">Nidd. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>מעשה ונ׳ הולד אחר וכ׳</he> it occurred that a twin child was born three months after its brother; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to gaze, be undecided, deliberate Num. R. s. 57 מה אתה עומד ומִשְׁתָּהֶה (some ed. ומִשְׁתָּהֶא) why dost thou stand and deliberate?; a. e.
